_comment: PLACEHOLDER rows for the showcase (variation) figure.

Row 'shape' = N realizations of ONE instruction (experiments/agentic_batch/run_realizations.sh, run k seeded S+k).  Here: the realization TEST runs (a wooden dining chair, N=2) in output/showcase_tests/run_realizations once finished; until then one run of one object (never different objects).

Row 'material' should hold N per-part material sweeps of one solved session (run_material_sweep.sh).  Here: the chess rook six times, its E field overridden per segment (E_override, heterogeneous, contrast 29-250x as the sweep's authoring rule asks) for the input panel only: the deformed panels are all the rook's own marble solve.
Row 'loading' should hold N load-case sweeps of one solved session (run_bc_sweep.sh).  Here: the sewing machine's one run, four times.

Real runs: SC_SHAPE_RUNS / SC_MATERIAL_RUNS / SC_LOADING_RUNS (space-separated folders or globs), or a JSON like this one via SC_ROWS_JSON.  A row given by an env var drops its placeholder flag.  See sc_prep.py.

rows.fallback_note: realization test runs not finished: one run of one object
